scope: Independent audit of CHEMBL1071707 / Morwick et al. DOI 10.1021/jm9014263 as a possible external ROCK2 evaluation set.

primary_sources.title: Hit to Lead Account of the Discovery of Bisbenzamide and Related Ureidobenzamide Inhibitors of Rho Kinase
primary_sources.citation_pages: J. Med. Chem. 2010, 53, 759-777; assay description p.761 and ROCK dose-response protocol p.777 in accessible article copy
primary_sources.copy_status: Secondary publisher-like PDF mirror used for text inspection; DOI/ACS page remains the primary citation.
primary_sources.retrieval_note: Downloaded through the storage wrapper for text inspection; secondary mirror, not the authority for citation.

confirmed_primary_method.construct: ROCK2 residues 1-543, with no GST fusion stated in the routine dose-response protocol (article p.777; SI p.S3)
confirmed_primary_method.ATP: 750 nM final in the routine luciferase assay; SI IMAP comparison uses 100 uM ATP and is a separate format
confirmed_primary_method.readout: Homogeneous Cambrex PKLight luciferin-luciferase detection of residual ATP; 90 min reaction at 28 C, then luminescence (article p.777). SI describes IMAP FP as a separate assay and reports approximately 2-4-fold higher IC50 values at 100 uM ATP.
confirmed_primary_method.endpoint: Enzyme inhibition IC50, reported in nM; not Kd/Ki and not cellular functional potency
confirmed_primary_method.luciferase_interference: The article reports that some dimethylaminomethylphenyl compounds inhibit the luciferase detection enzyme and that IMAP comparison was used to assess impact. Treat this as a readout-interference risk and preserve luciferase versus IMAP as distinct endpoints; do not interpret the 100 uM IMAP measurements as interchangeable calibration labels.

record_audit.flagged_issue: ChEMBL data_validity_comment='Outside typical range' occurs on 21 rows: 10 right-censored rows (activity IDs 3131686-3131695) and 11 exact rows (3131696-3131706), including values 102000-3200000 nM. Flags do not by themselves establish unit errors; preserve them and reconcile against the primary tables before freezing inclusion.
record_audit.out_of_assay_or_duplicate_check: The downloaded query is assay-specific. CHEMBL604249 appears twice within this assay under the same record_id 881722: activity 3131702 is 266000 nM and flagged Outside typical range, while activity 3131724 is 92 nM and unflagged. The molecule has identical canonical SMILES in both records. This is a material internal inconsistency, not a safe replicate to average.
record_audit.censoring_policy: The ten >6,000,000 or >7,000,000 nM rows are right-censored observations and cannot be converted to exact values; they account for the ten flagged censored rows.
record_audit.reconciliation_status: Superseded by data/phase18/source-table-reconciliation.json: 30 Table 4-7 analogue rows mapped, 17 documented 1000-fold µM-to-nM corrections, and both CHEMBL604249 records excluded.

source_mapping_checks.chembl_evidence: The raw records contain 266000 nM (activity 3131702, flagged) and 92 nM (activity 3131724, unflagged) for the same CHEMBL604249 structure.
source_mapping_checks.finding: Cannot establish which source row was intended for CHEMBL604249 from ChEMBL alone; the 266000 nM value conflicts with the article's 266 nM Table 6 value by three orders of magnitude, while 92 nM matches article entry 34. Exclude this molecule pending primary structure/compound-number reconciliation; do not silently choose 92 nM.
The SI confirms luciferase versus IMAP values and assay-format dependence, but ChEMBL activity JSON does not retain article compound numbers. Full compound-number mapping was not claimed.

eligibility_decision.reason: The primary study is a scientifically relevant independent biochemical ROCK2 source with a documented 1-543 construct, 750 nM ATP luciferase assay, and 500 nM peptide. The frozen source-table reconciliation maps 30 analogue rows, documents 17 source-supported 1000-fold µM-to-nM corrections, preserves censoring, and excludes both ambiguous CHEMBL604249 records. Remaining limits are assay interference, source-series overlap, and unknown pretrained-model overlap.
eligibility_decision.recommended_action: Use the frozen 30-row reconciled analogue panel for separately reported external evaluation/calibration. Do not reselect rows after seeing predictions; keep censored and excluded records in provenance.
eligibility_decision.training_overlap: Unknown. The series predates the current model but may occur in pretraining or related kinase datasets; no independence from pretrained model data is established.

reporting_requirements: Keep CHEMBL1071707 separate from Phase 17 CHEMBL4328667; do not pool their IC50 values.
Preserve original nM values, relations, activity IDs, ChEMBL validity flags, and assay metadata.
Use the 1-543 protein sequence and 750 nM ATP context as the primary assay description; do not substitute the SI's 100 uM IMAP condition.
Freeze treatment of the 11 flagged exact rows, 10 censored rows, and the 266000/92 nM conflict before any model evaluation.
Do not use a calibration result from this source as evidence for CEPT biology, ice inhibition, or prospective efficacy.

reconciliation_summary.qualified_panel_policy: Frozen reconciled rows only; right-censored rows remain separate and are not exact regression labels.
